source_of_truth.audit_basis: Finaldesign.zip + frozen mockups + A1-A6 contracts + B1 Overview freeze + B2 existing-pages product-truth sweep + B3 Actions final design + B4 Settings final design + B5 Financial/Report/Monitoring semantics + B6 Landing/Pilot/Pricing/Claims + B7 UI System 1.0 freeze + C1 Auth/Onboarding contract + C2 Legal/Public Essentials contract + C3 Checkout/Commerce States contract + C4 Global Product States contract

design_scope.title: Main Landingpage
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final public Product/Claim Truth frozen; D9 migrates production copy and pricing projection, while C2/C3/C5 own Legal, Commerce states and responsive acceptance.

design_scope.title: Pilotpage
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final pilot semantics frozen as controlled pilot, not General Availability or AppSource-live; production implementation remains D9.

design_scope.title: Login
design_scope.required_fix: C1 freezes the surrounding customer auth journey and access states; runtime implementation remains D6/D8 and acceptance E1/E3/E4.

design_scope.title: Invite / Registration / Verification / Password Reset / Access States
design_scope.required_fix: C1 final product/design truth frozen: credentials, MFA, verification and recovery remain identity-provider owned; BCSentinel resolves tenant membership and entitlement. Runtime remains D6/D8 and acceptance E1/E3/E4.

design_scope.title: Impressum / Datenschutz / Terms / DPA-AVV / Cookie Settings if required
design_scope.required_fix: C2 final scope frozen: DDG-based Impressum, real-stack Privacy, Product-Model-consistent Terms, customer DPA/AVV before processor activity, and conditional consent only when non-essential device access exists. D9 implements production copy/surfaces; final legal review remains a release gate.

design_scope.title: Checkout / Payment / Activation / Cancellation / Invoice states
design_scope.required_fix: C3 final commerce UX truth frozen: server-side ARV quote, provider-sync guard, explicit Payment Success -> Activation Pending -> Active progression, idempotent retries, recurring cancellation/renewal semantics and provider-backed invoice states. Runtime UI remains D6/D8/D9; real Stripe acceptance remains E4.

design_scope.title: 403 / 404 / 500 / Maintenance / Loading / Empty / Partial / Stale states
design_scope.required_fix: C4 final global state semantics frozen: zero, missing, empty, not-yet-available, partial and stale are distinct; Locked is distinct from 403/404; generic errors are sanitized and never fabricate KPI values. Runtime remains D6/D8, page-level implementation D7/D9 and final responsive acceptance C5.

design_scope.title: Dashboard Overview — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: Product/design truth frozen in B1; runtime implementation remains D6/D7 and final responsive acceptance remains C5

design_scope.title: Findings — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: B7 completes global component/token alignment; entitlement gating and BC operational boundaries remain fixed by B2. Runtime remains D7 and responsive acceptance C5.

design_scope.title: Actions — Free / Assessment / Monitoring
design_scope.required_fix: B3 final design frozen against remediation contract; runtime Remediation entity/read API/dashboard implementation remain D1/D3/D7

design_scope.title: Financial Impact
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final semantics frozen against fin-v1 and the shared backend financial projection; runtime implementation remains D7.

design_scope.title: Executive Summary Report — HTML + print/PDF
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final report semantics frozen; D10 later supplies one backend data contract for web, HTML and PDF without recalculating financial KPIs.

design_scope.title: Scans
design_scope.required_fix: Read-only history/status page frozen in B2; start, rerun and scope changes remain outside the web dashboard

design_scope.title: Monitoring Detail
design_scope.required_fix: B5 final monitoring semantics frozen: comparable-scope histories only, methodology-version aware, no summed Potential Saving and no Estimated Loss delta labeled as Realized Saving. Runtime remains D7.

design_scope.title: Monitoring Locked — Free / Assessment
design_scope.required_fix: Canonical Monitoring access state frozen in B2; Premium terminology is not allowed

design_scope.title: Settings / Tenant / Security
design_scope.required_fix: B4 final design frozen: only web-owned account preferences are editable; BC/Entra/Notifications remain read-only. C1 now freezes Auth/Onboarding; runtime remains D4/D8.

design_scope.title: Subscription / Billing
design_scope.required_fix: B6 final commerce/product presentation frozen; B6.1 supplies record-volume pricing; C3 freezes checkout/payment/activation/cancellation/invoice states. Assessment and Validation are one-time, Monitoring recurring, Free Entry is not a subscription. Real provider acceptance remains E4.

design_scope.title: Documentation / Support
design_scope.required_fix: B7 completes final UI-system alignment while preserving the B2 product-truth boundary: no phantom API, SLA or unsupported support channels.

manual_pilot_gates.en: BC SaaS role matrix: SETUP / SCHEDULER / ADMIN
Real checkout and entitlement grant smoke
SMTP delivery + SPF / DKIM / DMARC / bounce
Final release candidate freeze and sign-off

latest_developments.en: C4 freezes Global Product States at 99%: zero, missing, empty, not-yet-available, partial and stale are distinct; Locked is distinct from 403/404; 500/maintenance/error surfaces are sanitized and never fabricate business values.
latest_developments.de: C4 friert Global Product States bei 99% ein: Nullwert, fehlend, leer, noch nicht verfügbar, teilweise und veraltet sind getrennt; Locked ist von 403/404 getrennt; 500-/Maintenance-/Error-Flächen sind bereinigt und erfinden keine Business-Werte.

latest_developments.en: C3 freezes Checkout & Commerce States at 99%: checkout return/payment success is not authoritative access, activation-pending is explicit, retries are idempotent, Monitoring cancellation/renewal states are defined, and invoice presentation remains provider/runtime-backed.
latest_developments.de: C3 friert Checkout & Commerce States bei 99% ein: Checkout-Return/Payment Success ist noch kein autoritativer Zugriff, Activation Pending ist explizit, Retries sind idempotent, Monitoring-Kündigungs-/Renewal-States sind definiert und Rechnungsdarstellung bleibt provider-/runtime-basiert.

latest_developments.en: C2 freezes Legal / Public Essentials at 99%: Impressum follows current DDG semantics, Privacy must match the real production stack, DPA/AVV is required before processor activity, and consent is conditional rather than shown by default.
latest_developments.de: C2 friert Legal / Public Essentials bei 99% ein: Das Impressum folgt der aktuellen DDG-Semantik, Datenschutz muss dem realen Production-Stack entsprechen, AVV/DPA ist vor Processor-Tätigkeit erforderlich und Consent wird nur bei tatsächlichem Bedarf aktiviert.

latest_developments.en: Business Central remains the operational write authority while the web dashboard is primarily read-only.
latest_developments.de: Business Central bleibt die operative Write-Authority, während das Web-Dashboard primär read-only ist.
